card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 59 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 11.1 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 58.7 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 2,004 parsecs away.
